_note: Reviewed corrections to a quotation or the page it cites, applied in scripts/ingest.mjs (as year-overrides.json is). Key: an occurrence id, or family:<id> / archetype:<id> / theoretic:<id> for a definition. A fix: text (the corrected verbatim words), locator and work (the cite the quote stands on, which becomes the primary cite; for a definition, cite: the cite string), basis (the line that proves it: the corpus page the words stand on). The vault is never edited; this layer is the correction.
